header: I build the prompt that turns a question into ONE read-only SELECT. Three parts matter most: (1) an exact description of what the views hold and what the domain words mean, (2) the PHONETIC LAYER taught as vocabulary and recipes, (3) worked examples. Everything here is teaching text, not logic: to improve the system, edit this text or add examples.

doc: I describe this to the model ONLY when the question is about a health check-up; the rest of the time the prompt is exactly what it was.

members.name: rejectedSql
doc: SQL this person has already marked wrong for this exact question.

members.name: repair
doc: I set this on a repair attempt: what went wrong with the previous SQL.

members.name: negatives
doc: Readings people marked WRONG for similar questions, learned from "No" answers.

members.name: hint
doc: I set this on a second attempt after a "No": the person's reason, as an instruction.
